preceding_protocol: SV2-UX-01 as merged into dev (#2595): PUT /api/swarm/<slug> accepts start, pause, stop, stop_now, close, reopen, terminate, set, verdict, restore-decision, lift, doctor_start, doctor_stop and quota_refresh; GET returns the swarm view with commands, terminals and executions; every agent row shows message and terminate

unchanged.behavior: every preceding PUT action keeps its body, validation and 200, 400, 403 and 502 answers

terminate keeps its server path and its button when the view has no lifecycle offers or the rollback switch is off; with lifecycle offers and the switch on, force stop replaces it because terminate is not fenced on generation and terminate-agent acts only on local processes
commands.submit queues the same pending row; it is now prepare plus enqueue
the swarm view still never reads the ledger; swarm_status reads only the published snapshot
SV2-UX-01 execution cards are computed the same way

added.answers: 200 with the swarm view, 400 malformed, 403 destructive without the operator, 409 stale or unresolved or reused operation id, 422 unsupported or turned off, 502 swarm store error, 503 contention

added.shape: controls, destructive, agents (incarnation, generation, task_revision, pending, disabled, terminate), operations, conflicts, ledger_control_conflicts_total
task id to the revision of its state stamp

local_compatibility: A page served by an older ledger server shows no lifecycle key and keeps its message and terminate buttons; an older page against this server never sends action lifecycle and sees only an extra view key it ignores.
